title: Lit Up 26.2 Panorama
description: A re-creation of the Chaos Cubed main menu panorama, but with Torches.
body:
## About the Resourcepack
**Lit Up 26.2 Panorama** is a simple but nice Resourcepack that replaces the main menu panorama with a hand-made, almost **1:1** re-creation of the Java Chaos Cubed panorama, but with added Torches to make it brighter.

I got inspired to make this pack after seeing people's feedback online to [26.2 Snapshot 7](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_26.2_Snapshot_7) and many people saying that the Vanilla panorama is way too dark, so I decided to spend a couple of days re-creating the Sulphur Cave seen in the panorama, either by hand or with the help of tools like Dart Spark's [MCV](https://dartjs.com/mcv).

The finished result is a combination of the Vanilla panorama, plus my lit-up version overlaid on top of it.

# Additional Info

I've decided to share the creative world I built the panorama re-creation in, so if you want to check it out and give it a deeper look you can find it [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HVlRTImnViWY5guVAA1-9Fiddy3dWR7_/view?usp=sharing). Note though that I **only** recreated what's seen in the Vanilla panorama, so if you start moving, the façade can quickly fall apart. It also it doesn't include every part of the panorama, because as I mentioned above, parts of it come from the Vanilla one.

If you want to edit and/or redistribute the world linked above, please contact me via Gmail (happyfiedyt@gmail.com) or Discord (@happyfied).
Using the pack and world in a video, modpack or other work is fine as long as proper credit is given.
